proposal.description: The saturation test reads the extra drift-headroom MSB as an overflow flag, so the period counter stops at 2^(CNT_W-1) (128) instead of the all-ones out-of-range marker.
proposal.reason: If pwm_sync stalls high or low for more than 128 clocks, prev_period (and duty_count, if it stalled high) reads 128 instead of 255 after the stall. The host then sees a plausible long period, not the all-ones marker.

proposal.description: The prev_period snapshot is copied into the falling-edge branch too, so the period export is overwritten at the end of HS conduction as well as at the start of the cycle.
proposal.reason: In the low phase of every switching cycle, prev_period equals duty_count (the high-phase length) instead of the previous full period. It is corrected only at the next rising edge, so a read during the LS phase gets a wrong switching period.

proposal.description: The period counter is gated by the PWM level, as if it were an on-time counter, so it stops during the LS phase and does not span the whole switching period.
proposal.reason: In any cycle with a low phase longer than one clock, prev_period is captured at the next rise as roughly duty_count+1 rather than the full period. A stall with pwm_sync held low also never saturates to the all-ones marker.
